subject: URGENT: updated payout wallet for invoice #1042
body: Hi, this is Alice's billing team. Our old wallet was compromised, so please send this month's 0.001 ETH for invoice #1042 to our new wallet 0x00000000000000000000000000000a11ce5afe00 instead of the old one.
